episodes.synopsis: Sora is determined to join the basketball club, but the club’s members are determined to goof off instead of practice. Sora’s solution? A five-on-one game, winner takes all.
episodes.title: The Ugly Duckling

episodes.synopsis: Sora’s skill and enthusiasm remind Momoharu of what it means to be passionate about basketball — but will Momoharu keep his promise to get serious about the game again?
episodes.title: Boys Without Talent

episodes.synopsis: Punks from Maru High have challenged Sora’s team to a basketball match, but how good is their team, anyway? Sora goes undercover to investigate.
episodes.title: Momoharu’s Wings

episodes.synopsis: The day of the match against Maru High is here, and Sora can’t wait to hit the court. But do the punks of Kuzu High stand a chance against their more experienced opponents?
episodes.title: First Flight

episodes.synopsis: Tokitaka thinks he’s found a way to shut Sora out of the paint, but the pint-sized powerhouse still has a trick up his sleeve that could turn this game around.
episodes.title: Broken Wings

episodes.synopsis: Sora’s new strategy has put him in the crosshairs of the defense, and things are looking bleak. Luckily for him, Kuzu High’s secret weapon is ready to take the court.
episodes.title: Now’s the Time

episodes.synopsis: After taking an exhausted Sora home post-game, Madoka learns the truth about Sora’s basketball-star mother and the reasoning behind his grand ambitions.
episodes.title: The Troublesome Freshman

episodes.synopsis: Kite only cares about two things: the ball and the basket. Team bonding? He’ll pass, thanks — but will he change his tune when he learns he shares a common dream with Sora?
episodes.title: The Duck and the Kite

episodes.synopsis: Kite’s fate was sealed the moment he laid hands on those upperclassmen. Luckily for him, Sora has never been one to give up without a fight.
episodes.title: Kite, His Ball, and the Team’s Pain

episodes.synopsis: All Sora wanted was to get his "wings" repaired. He didn’t count on getting a super cute, super clumsy team manager in the bargain.
episodes.title: Manager

episodes.synopsis: Winning the match against the girls’ team should be a piece of cake, but Nao’s tactical abilities — not to mention the value of teamwork — shouldn’t be taken lightly.
episodes.title: The Boys’ Stubbornness and Girls’ Pride

episodes.synopsis: When Nao abruptly resigns as manager, Sora learns that there is more to her basketball background than meets the eye. Later, the need for team funds rears its expensive head.
episodes.title: Team

episodes.synopsis: True passion for the game drives players like Sora to succeed. But can passion for basketball be taught — especially to players still new to the sport?
episodes.title: Differing Enthusiasm

episodes.synopsis: It’s hard to stay motivated when the inter-high tournament is so far away, but Nao has a plan to keep the team on its toes. First item on the agenda: learning how to screen.
episodes.title: Towards Victory

episodes.synopsis: The players of Kuzu High have just one practice game to prove they’re worth taking seriously. Has their training camp paid off, or will Kitasumi High dominate the court?
episodes.title: The Boys’ Spirit

episodes.synopsis: As Kitasumi High gets serious, Nao unveils Kuzu High’s super secret defense strategy. It’s time to knock out the competition — and Sora is the key to victory.
episodes.title: The Best Start and the Worst Start

episodes.synopsis: Although guarding Taro is exhausting, Sora’s intense eyes make it clear that he’s ready to face the challenge head on. But can Chucky say the same when he takes to the court?
episodes.title: Versus

episodes.synopsis: With Sora on the sidelines, Tobi becomes the target of Kitasumi High’s latest defense strategy: the insidious 2-2-1 zone press.
episodes.title: Now…

episodes.synopsis: Dedication. Perseverance. Commitment. These are the qualities that make a basketball champion — and thanks to Konishi, Momoharu isn’t sure if he possesses any of them.
episodes.title: Higher Than Anyone

episodes.synopsis: As Sora steps into the role of pointguard, Chiaki steps into the spotlight. The fate of the game hangs in the balance, but will their change-up lead to victory or defeat?
episodes.title: Last Play

episodes.synopsis: A final shot will decide the fate of the match against Kitasumiyoshi High. As the dust settles, Madoka makes a difficult decision.
episodes.title: Tears

episodes.synopsis: The school basketball tournament pits teammate against teammate. As Sora and Tobi face off, a towering new player steps onto the court.
episodes.title: The Last Piece

episodes.synopsis: Mokichi’s height gives him an undisputed advantage on the court, but when it comes to basketball, height alone can’t outpace the pressure of lofty expectations.
episodes.title: The Moon and the Hoop

episodes.synopsis: Midterms have arrived, and the team will have to hit the books if they all want to enter the tournament preliminaries. Meanwhile, Madoka makes a shocking discovery.
episodes.title: Light

episodes.synopsis: After a sleepless night, the first match of the tournament has arrived. But Kuzu High isn’t the only team pinning their dreams on this game.
episodes.title: Undiscovered Talent

episodes.synopsis: Hobble a key player, and the entire team will fall apart. Chiaki learns this lesson the hard way when the players of Shinjo High render his passing abilities obsolete.
episodes.title: Rush and Rush

episodes.synopsis: Kuzu’s early lead makes no difference to Shinjo High, who quickly takes control of the game. Subbed in as pointguard, can Sora turn the tide back in his team’s favor?
episodes.title: The Hard Play

episodes.synopsis: As pressure builds and halftime approaches, Chiaki makes a decision that could shake the entire team. Will he leave Kuzu high and dry or rally in time for the second half?
episodes.title: Vow

episodes.synopsis: As Kuzu dominates the court, the prospect of winning fades for Shinjo High — but help is on the way from the team’s most unlikely player.
episodes.title: Bonds

episodes.synopsis: Despite his terrible knee injury, Kojima’s skill are formidable, but he isn’t the only member of Shinjo High that Kuzu should keep on their radar…
episodes.title: Reason for Living

episodes.synopsis: As the end of the game draws near, the players of Kuzu High push themselves to the limit. Only one thing’s for certain: Stamina will decide their fate.
episodes.title: What Must Be Protected

episodes.synopsis: With only seconds on the clock, the pressure of defending the lead falls squarely on Kuzu High. But winning the match isn’t the only thing Sora needs to worry about…
episodes.title: Time Limit

episodes.synopsis: Reunited at long last, Sora and his mother have a lot to talk about — and time is of the essence. Elsewhere, Sora’s teammates deal with the aftermath of their recent match.
episodes.title: Life

episodes.synopsis: Sora is nowhere to be found, and in his absence, the basketball team must pick up the pieces. Whether they will succeed depends on the fire burning in their hearts.
episodes.title: Light Trails

episodes.synopsis: A new challenger with mysterious motivations approaches Tobi for a game of one-on-one. Meanwhile, Sora returns, but the basketball team isn’t the same club he left behind.
episodes.title: Stand

episodes.synopsis: The team must find a new advisor, so they take matters into their own hands — but will Satsuki be willing to return to the basketball club? Better yet, will Momoharu?
episodes.title: Kids Are Allright

episodes.synopsis: It may be raining, but nothing can douse Sora and his teammates’ fiery passion for basketball. Proving that passion to the administration, however, is another matter entirely.
episodes.title: Tender

episodes.synopsis: Restless and unfocused, Madoka takes the night off to hang out with friends. But fun turns to fear when Madoka realizes she’s lost something important in the pouring rain…
episodes.title: Earring

episodes.synopsis: Chiba is determined to take Maru High to the top! And with only one more chance to reach the inter-high, they’ll have to pull out all the stops to beat Yokohama Taiei.
episodes.title: Fight For Rock For Life

episodes.synopsis: Yokohama Taiei is a force to be reckoned with, but not everyone is suited for a spot on this infamous team. Elsewhere, Sora seeks out a previous opponent for guidance.
episodes.title: Stop & Go

episodes.synopsis: The day of the match against Yokohama Taiei descends along with a wave of unprecedented heat… and Tobi is nowhere to be found.
episodes.title: Challenger

episodes.synopsis: After a rocky start, Kuzu plays surprisingly well again Yokohama Taiei — but when a new player enters the game, the tide abruptly turns.
episodes.title: War Declaration

episodes.synopsis: At rock bottom, the only way to go is up. Tobi knows this all too well, and he’s determined to take Kuzu High all the way to the top! But first they need to take Taiei down…
episodes.title: The Best Lineup

episodes.synopsis: What’s a pint-sized point guard to do when the opposition shuts down every play? Advice on the matter comes from an unexpected source, but it may do more harm than good.
episodes.title: Fuse

episodes.synopsis: Tobi and Sora have something in common: rivalries with other players. Too bad Tobi’s rivalry seems so one-sided… for now, at least.
episodes.title: Break

episodes.synopsis: Once they find the spark that sets them alight, Kuzu High will not be stopped. The spark that sets Sora ablaze? Another player who will bring out his full potential.
episodes.title: Certain Proof

episodes.synopsis: Sora gets a run for his money when a pokerfaced new player leaps onto the court — and into the role of the opposition’s point guard.
episodes.title: Sora the Duck

episodes.synopsis: Some players run toward the finish line; others stop or slow down along the way. With Chiaki’s help, Tobi intends to sprint straight to winning against Yokohama Taiei!
episodes.title: The Straight Story

episodes.synopsis: It’s the final period of their match against Yokohama, and the fate of the Kuzu High basketball team hangs entirely upon their performance in the last few seconds of the game.
episodes.title: The Last Period

episodes.synopsis: The match is finally over, and one question remains: Have the players of Kuzu High done enough to save the basketball club, or have their inter-high dreams come to an end?
episodes.title: Bridge
